body: You might be ending up facing other established alt accounts that were built to brickwall players at the bottom of a fresh tier. Other than that you just tiered up and may need to grind some fresh gear to get competitive again.

author: petr1petr
body:
you need some good gears of your tier

weapon is important - having element on melee weapon is not very good idea - remove it.

maybe it is time, to find out more about skills that you are using - if enemy has high stats, you want to use skills with high penetration (M1) - check here (section skills):  [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1H1Fa-J8DgF-5rkupEbOW90cREhmr6xukn\_jGstjEfmo/edit?gid=165761277#gid=165761277](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1H1Fa-J8DgF-5rkupEbOW90cREhmr6xukn_jGstjEfmo/edit?gid=165761277#gid=165761277)

it is also time to learn to use equipment/skill tabs - PVP is for PVP - default is for world (+view equips)
